desc: The model must not call update_goal when the user asks to pause (lifecycle is user-owned).
pause_goal is removed; the user pauses via /goal-pause.
abort_goal is removed; abandonment is user-owned via /goal-clear.
propose_goal_tweak is removed; tweaks are user-owned via /goal-tweak.
The model must not edit goal files directly (no write/edit to .pi/goals paths).
